source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that approved AMD North Bridge firmware settings survive save/reboot and that Load Default restores the documented values while preserving the expected memory topology, NUMA presentation, PCIe resource allocation, accelerator/device visibility and boot stability.
original_method: A human changes a bounded North Bridge setting set in BIOS, saves and re-enters Setup to verify persistence, then loads defaults, saves/reboots and visually compares the same fields with SPEC while platform resources are checked for unintended change.
manual_activity: An engineer must interpret and operate the pre-OS North Bridge page, approve resource-affecting changes, complete both reboot phases and visually verify persistence/defaults. Software topology collection cannot replace this core acceptance.
required_inputs: Board, BIOS, AGESA, CPU and chipset revision
Exact field meanings and memory/NUMA/PCIe/device dependencies
Approved baseline, non-default and SPEC-default values
Expected DIMM, NUMA, PCIe/GPU/accelerator and boot topology
safety_requirements: Do not execute all/random; change only individually approved fields whose allocation and interconnect effects are known.
Preserve a topology baseline that identifies every critical DIMM, NUMA node, PCIe endpoint and boot path.
Do not infer safe values across different CPU, board, AGESA or populated-slot configurations.
Stop on memory loss, corrected/uncorrected memory events, PCIe/GPU disappearance, boot hang or management loss.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only firmware identity, memory capacity/topology, NUMA, PCIe/GPU, boot, OS log and BMC evidence.
Compare resource maps across operator-controlled phases and flag deltas.
Do not navigate BIOS, set resource controls or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact North Bridge field/value/default and expected resource matrix.
Perform and capture the persistence and Load Default operations.
Assess topology/resource evidence and own the final verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly states that the agent cannot perform the BIOS workflow. No source command is present, and OS topology tools cannot prove a Setup field value.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the firmware method; use versioned read-only memory/NUMA/PCIe inventories solely to correlate consequences of each named field.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source lifecycle, null script and 5/5-minute fields are retained. The literal all/random text is not authorization for unbounded resource changes.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-field matrix linking firmware value, memory/NUMA/PCIe effect and critical endpoints; capture topology before mutation, after persistence, after defaults and after final restoration.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the recorded AMD board, CPU population, BIOS/AGESA revision and installed resource topology.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, BMC, AGESA, CPU, OS/kernel and inventory-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform North Bridge field definitions plus board and AMD documentation for the exact CPU/AGESA generation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a bounded resource model and rejects random changes.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Extends observable resource coverage without replacing BIOS persistence/default checks.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field semantics, topology, default matrix and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A booting OS does not prove that capacity, locality or PCIe allocation remained correct; topology deltas need engineer interpretation.

project_override_considerations: A project can approve a subset of fields based on the populated memory and PCIe configuration. The report must name that subset and must not claim full page or alternate-topology coverage.
expected_evidence: Platform and populated-topology identity, field/resource matrix, approval and recovery
Baseline memory capacity/topology, NUMA nodes, PCIe/GPU endpoints and boot state
Non-default captures, persistence and exact resource delta
Default captures, SPEC comparison and topology/boot/management health
Final approved topology, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The two-phase persistence/default workflow and criteria agree. Absent field values and topology are project readiness inputs, not contradictory requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The North Bridge configuration lifecycle is clear. A safe matrix and recovery are required for execution but do not make the library case intrinsically blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Confirms the manual boundary and adds North Bridge-specific resource controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps its topology, recovery and evidence improvements but corrects the classification from partial to manual.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates core human firmware acceptance from automated resource observation and constrains applicability to the exact populated topology.

review_improvement: Makes memory/NUMA/PCIe resource preservation an explicit acceptance dimension rather than treating the page as a generic BIOS menu.
independent_technical_reasoning: The decisive actions and evidence are BIOS navigation, interpretation and visual comparison, all human-controlled. Automated topology snapshots are valuable collateral-effect evidence but do not execute the test; therefore the case is MANUAL ONLY.
no_automatic_retry: If memory, NUMA, PCIe, accelerator, boot or management state is abnormal, preserve the first result and do not repeat changes or reboot phases without engineer disposition.
